missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Лето' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Жаркое' is the agreeing neuter adjective describing it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Лето' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'; the neuter form matches the nominative. A clean object example.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Лета' is genitive showing whose end it is. 'Конца' is itself genitive after 'ждём', which governs the genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Лету' is the dative form after 'к' to express a time goal. 'Денег' is the genitive of quantity.

missions.phrase: Этим летом я еду на море.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of time. 'Летом' is the instrumental used to mean in summer. 'Этим' agrees in the neuter instrumental, and 'на море' is the destination.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Лете' is the prepositional form after 'о' to give the topic. 'Прошлом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Лето' is nominative as the doer of 'прошло', which agrees in neuter gender. 'Быстро' adds the manner.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Лете' is prepositional after 'о' to mark what is dreamed about. 'Тёплом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Лета' is the nominative plural meaning past summers. 'Прошедшие' agrees in the plural, and 'жаркими' is the instrumental predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative of duration. 'Лето' is the accusative expressing how long the rain lasted; the neuter form matches the nominative. 'Целое' agrees with it.
